description: A QSwap pool's reserves (QU and tokens), total liquidity units and price, read from the contract. It shows how deep a pool is. Adding or removing liquidity each cost a flat 100,000 QU on top of any deposit. Read-only.

asset.description: Asset symbol, for example CFB or QDOGE (case does not matter). qmax_list_assets lists the tradable symbols.
